You are a programming expert.

Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 3faf12cd8603e3efbcc7e570e07dfd1ea2a17095 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Date: Fri, 7 Oct 2011 08:31:41 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: tegra: fix compilation error due to mach/hardware.h
 removal

This fixes a compilation error in cpu-tegra.c which was introduced in
dc8d966bccde ("ARM: convert PCI defines to variables") which removed the
now obsolete mach/hardware.h from the mach-tegra subtree.

Signed-off-by: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Signed-off-by: Olof Johansson <olof@lixom.net>
Cc: Sergei Shtylyov <sshtylyov@ru.mvista.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c b/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
index 0e1016a827ac..0e0fd4d889bd 100644
--- a/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
+++ b/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
@@ -32,7 +32,6 @@
 
 #include <asm/system.h>
 
-#include <mach/hardware.h>
 #include <mach/clk.h>
 
 /* Frequency table index must be sequential starting at 0 */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c`**
   - The line `#include <mach/hardware.h>` has been removed.

### Relationships

- The modification in `cpu-tegra.c` addresses a compilation error that arose from the removal of the `mach/hardware.h` header file in a previous commit (`dc8d966bccde`). This change ensures that the code compiles correctly by eliminating the inclusion of an obsolete header that is no longer available in the codebase.

Code statements included in point 1 should be as brief as possible, only include the ones that are most related to the root cause and  the number of code statements may not exceed 3.


Here is the commit message:
ARM: tegra: fix compilation error due to mach/hardware.h
 removal

This fixes a compilation error in cpu-tegra.c which was introduced in
dc8d966bccde ("ARM: convert PCI defines to variables") which removed the
now obsolete mach/hardware.h from the mach-tegra subtree.

Signed-off-by: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Signed-off-by: Olof Johansson <olof@lixom.net>
Cc: Sergei Shtylyov <sshtylyov@ru.mvista.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the `mach/hardware.h` header file in a previous commit, which led to a compilation error in `cpu-tegra.c` due to the absence of necessary definitions or declarations that were previously provided by that header file.

Here is the patch:
 #include <asm/system.h>
 
-#include <mach/hardware.h>
 #include <mach/clk.h>

Reason:
